scope: Select the first unresolved SIL Bangladesh survey-program report with affirmative lexical or wordlist evidence in census order, after excluding Chak, Chittagonian, Chakma-Tanchangya, and Marma-Rakhine because each already has an active acquisition audit.
policy: A report may be selected only when it remains outside the excluded active audits and the audit record affirmatively establishes lexical or wordlist evidence. Secondary evidence may classify a candidate but may never supply or verify a lexical or IPA reading. No page, list, cell, or topology may be invented without the complete primary report.

selection.reason: The only six unresolved program rows belong to the four explicitly excluded active audits. Chak is the only one with affirmative evidence of lexical or IPA content, and it is explicitly excluded. No unresolved report remains after applying the required exclusions.

next_action: Do not invent or promote a replacement candidate. Continue one of the four active acquisition audits when its complete primary report becomes available, or obtain explicit authorization to broaden the search beyond unresolved survey-program candidates. Any acquired primary report must be checksummed and rendered before topology is established; image-only or handwritten IPA must then be transcribed manually cell by cell from rendered pages.
